title: Set 75

sentences.ko: 집주인이 2년 더 계약하면 월세를 100달러 깎아 주겠다고 했어. 1년 전 같았으면 그 자리에서 바로 좋다고 했을 거야. 그런데 엄마가 6월부터 병원에 들어갔다 나왔다 하시는데 차로 세 시간 거리라, 솔직히 봄에 내가 어디 있어야 할지를 모르겠어. 집주인은 이번 주에 답을 달라는데 나는 아직 답장도 못 썼어.
sentences.text: My landlord said he'd take a hundred off the rent if we sign for another two years, and a year ago I would have said yes on the spot. But my mom's been in and out of the hospital since June and she's three hours away, so I honestly don't know where I need to be by spring. He wants an answer this week and I still haven't written him back.

alts.text: So my landlord says he'll knock a hundred off the rent if we re-sign for two more years, and a year ago I'd have said yes right there. But my mom's been in and out of the hospital since June and she's three hours away, so I honestly have no idea where I need to be by spring. He wants an answer this week and I haven't even written back yet.

My landlord has offered to reduce the rent by a hundred dollars if we sign for another two years, and a year ago I would have accepted immediately. However, my mother has been in and out of the hospital since June and she lives three hours away, so I genuinely do not know where I will need to be by spring. He would like an answer this week, and I have not yet replied to him.

sentences.note: **on the spot** 은 생각할 것도 없이 그 자리에서 바로 라는 뜻입니다. **in and out of the hospital** 은 입원과 퇴원을 되풀이한다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 일요일에 제니가 나를 수영장에 데리고 가서 스무 바퀴쯤 돌았어, 그게 다야. 그런데 대학 때 이후로 수영을 안 했었거든. 지금 아픈 데가 옆구리야, 거기가 아플 수 있다는 건 생각도 못 했는데. 그래서 회사에서 누가 웃기면 그냥 앉아서 참는 수밖에 없어.
sentences.text: Jenny got me in the pool on Sunday and I did maybe twenty laps, that's it, but I hadn't been swimming since college. And now it's my sides that hurt, which I didn't even know was a thing, so every time somebody makes me laugh at work I just have to sit there and take it.

alts.text: Jenny dragged me to the pool Sunday and I did like twenty laps, that's all, but I hadn't been in a pool since college. And now it's my sides that hurt, which I didn't even know could happen, so anytime somebody makes me laugh at work I've just gotta sit there and take it.

Jenny got me into the pool on Sunday and I completed perhaps twenty laps, no more, but I had not been swimming since college. Now it is my sides that ache, which I did not know was possible, so whenever someone makes me laugh at work I simply have to sit there and endure it.

sentences.note: **sit there and take it** 은 어떻게 하지도 못하고 그냥 참고 있는다는 뜻입니다. 중간의 **that's it** 은 딱 그게 다야 하고 선을 긋는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 윗집 사람이 밤에 일해서 새벽 한 시쯤 들어오는데, 그때 세탁기며 청소기며 할 걸 다 해. 그런데 사람이 좋아. 지난겨울 내내 우리 집 계단 눈을 치워 줬거든. 그러니까 찾아가서 문을 두드릴 마음이 안 생겨. 그래서 지금은 새벽 한 시에 누워서, 나한테 아무 잘못도 안 한 사람한테 혼자 짜증만 내고 있어.
sentences.text: The guy above us works nights, so he gets in around one and that's when he does everything, the washing machine, the vacuum, all of it. And he's a nice guy, he shoveled our steps all last winter, so I can't make myself go knock on his door about it. So now I just lie there at one in the morning being annoyed at somebody who's never done anything to me.

alts.text: The guy upstairs works nights, so he gets home like one in the morning and that's when he does everything, laundry, vacuum, all of it. And he's a nice guy, he shoveled our steps all last winter, so I can't make myself go bang on his door about it. So now I'm just lying there at one a.m. mad at a guy who's never done anything to me.

The man who lives above us works nights, so he arrives home around one, and that is when he does everything: the washing machine, the vacuum, all of it. He is a kind man, and he shoveled our steps all last winter, so I cannot make myself knock on his door about it. So now I simply lie there at one in the morning, irritated with someone who has never done anything to me.

sentences.note: **I can't make myself** 는 해야 하는 줄 알면서도 도저히 마음이 안 내켜 못 한다는 뜻입니다. **works nights** 는 밤에 일한다, 즉 야간 근무를 한다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 자, 그동안 어떻게 됐는지 좀 얘기해 줘. 내가 아는 건 전부 너희 엄마가 우리 엄마한테 하신 말을 건너 들은 거라서. 내가 들은 얘기로는 너 이제 네 일 한다며. 그게 언제부터야? 그걸로 돈은 이제 좀 벌어? 아니면 아직은 다들 조급해하지 말라고만 하는 단계야?
sentences.text: Okay, catch me up, because everything I know came from your mom through my mom, and the version I got is that you're doing your own thing now. When did that happen? And are you actually making money at it yet, or is this still the part where everybody tells you to be patient?

alts.text: Okay, fill me in, 'cause everything I know is your mom telling my mom, and what I got was you're doing your own thing now. Since when? And are you making any money at it yet, or is this still the part where everybody just tells you to be patient?

Please bring me up to date, because everything I know came from your mother by way of my mother, and the version I received is that you are working for yourself now. When did that come about? And are you actually earning money from it yet, or is this still the stage at which everyone advises you to be patient?

sentences.note: **catch me up** 과 **fill me in** 은 둘 다 내가 못 들은 동안의 소식을 알려 달라는 말입니다. **doing your own thing** 은 여기서 남 밑에 있지 않고 자기 일을 한다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 이 코트 여름에 반값이길래 샀거든. 현관에서 10초쯤 걸쳐 보고 그냥 걸어 뒀어. 이제 날이 추워져서 제대로 입어 봤더니 소매가 짧아. 무슨 애들 옷 작아지듯이 말이야. 반품 기간은 8월에 끝났고, 그걸로 끝이지 뭐. 코트는 좋은데 그래서 더 속상해.
sentences.text: I bought this coat back in the summer because it was half off, and I tried it on for about ten seconds in the hallway and then just hung it up. So now it's finally cold and I put it on properly, and the sleeves are short on me, like I'm growing out of it. And the return window closed in August, so that's that. It's a nice coat, which somehow makes it worse.

alts.text: So I grabbed this coat back in the summer 'cause it was half off, tried it on for like ten seconds in the hallway, and just hung it up. Now it's finally cold, I put it on for real, and the sleeves are short on me, like I'm growing out of it. Return window closed in August, so that's that. It's a nice coat, which somehow makes it worse.

I purchased this coat back in the summer because it was half price, and I tried it on for roughly ten seconds in the hallway and then simply hung it up. Now that it is finally cold I have put it on properly, and the sleeves are short on me, as though I am growing out of it. The return window closed in August, so there is nothing to be done. It is a lovely coat, which somehow makes it worse.

sentences.note: **half off** 는 반값이라는 뜻입니다. **so that's that** 은 더 어쩔 수 없으니 이야기는 여기서 끝이라는 말입니다.

reviewed: 3번 note 가 **I can't bring myself to** 를 가르치는데 영어 본문에는 "can't make myself" 로 되어 있었다. 본문에 실제로 나오는 표현을 짚도록 note 를 고쳤다.
영국식 철자가 섞여 있었다 (3번 casual 의 neighbour, 3번 formal 의 shovelled, 2번 formal 의 realise). 본문이 미국식(shoveled)이라 미국식으로 통일했다.
2번 casual 의 "I hadn't swum since college" 는 말할 때 잘 안 쓰는 형태라 "I hadn't been in a pool since college" 로 바꿨다.
2번 한국어의 "끌고 가서" 는 casual 쪽(dragged)의 말이고 본문은 "got me in the pool" 이라 "데리고 가서" 로 맞췄다. "거기가 아플 수도" 도 본문 뜻에 맞게 다듬었다.
1·3·4·5번 casual 이 본문과 뒷부분이 거의 그대로 겹쳐 있었다. 말투만 바꾼 것이 아니라 더 짧고 축약된 구어가 되도록 다시 썼다 (knock a hundred off, gets home like one, laundry, 'cause, for real 등).
1번 formal 에서 금액에 단위가 없어 "a hundred dollars" 로 적었다. 한국어(100달러)와 같아졌다.
3번 formal 의 "The gentleman above us" 가 어색해서 "The man who lives above us" 로 바꿨다.
